steps.npc: Nothing yet, you scallywag, but keep checking in. I'm sure he'll have something soon. Now, what will it be?

options.text: Got any work that needs doing here?

steps.player: Got any work that needs doing here?

steps.npc: Well, it just so happens that I'm looking for a rough, tough, piratical type for an adventure on the high seas!

options.text: Could you tell me about the Pandemonium's one rule?

steps.player: Could you tell me about the Pandemonium's one rule?

steps.npc: Avast! The mainland kingdoms have no authority here. Their laws do not apply. Instead, we just have our one rule that keeps the Pandemonium afloat: Never disrespect your fellow patron.
We don't care who you are. Indeed, pirates and customs officers can enjoy a drink here, side by side. Savvy?

steps.player: So anyone is welcome here as long as they don't commit an offense against any of the other patrons?

steps.npc: Yarr! You've got it! Now, what will it be?
